info.title: CurriculumOS first-unit API
info.description: Design contract, not deployed endpoints. Base path /api/v1. Additional authoring/provisioning/correction-approval APIs follow in their work packages. See engineering specification for invariants.

get.summary: Published curriculum only; school-authored scope checked
get.description: Enforce current resource relationships, school isolation and pinned academic state. Private responses use Cache-Control: no-store; paginate authorized scopes, never unrestricted school data.

200.description: Authorized result; repeated command returns the same committed receipt.

sessionCookie.name: session
sessionCookie.description: Logical authenticated server-session scheme. Supabase SSR cookie names are adapter details; do not implement a second custom session system. Same-origin/CSRF defenses required on commands.

Error.description: Current revision/draft included only for an already authorized revision conflict; never disclose data on tenant/access denial.
